title: Direct prompt injection & jailbreak
summary: The user is the attacker. No poison document. A chat message steers the planner into the same dump you just did by hand — and the executor still has to say no.
takeaway: Direct injection uses the chat box. Indirect injection uses retrieval. Same payload, different channel — both are LLM01.
design_rule: Assume the planner can be steered. Authorization lives in the executor, not in the prompt.
